_comment: The qalam mascot's every tunable value. Colour and motion timings are NOT here on purpose, those come from theme.json so the mascot always matches the rest of the app. Whether it is shown at all is the reader's choice, in settings.json.
_size_comment: The pen used to stand beside a title two lines tall and was sized to match it. The title is gone and the pen is a button now, so header is sized as a button: big enough to be an easy target, and the badge around it grows to suit rather than the pen shrinking to fit the badge. ink is the small pen writing its gold line while an answer is on its way (ui/feedback/Skeleton.jsx).
